race.description: Somerset Farms Trotters Up To Nr55 Mbl
race.comment: MACKEL SONNY (7) was good from a 40m handicap last start, racing wide late before finishing 6 metres from the winner in third at this circuit and distance, his fourth placing in a row. The driver has some work to do from this wide starting position but his hoof is on the till. GAZ MAN NZ (2) was another that came from the 40m mark last start and finished fourth. A nice draw on the front line should ensure a cosy run. Big chance. FENOMENAL (3) has had some tough handicaps of late but placed from the back line the last time he started behind a mobile. Player from a good draw. MOREEP (5) must be respected after scoring last start by 9 metres at this circuit and distance, giving him two wins and a second from the last three outings.
